citation.quoted_text: A.T. Holdings II LTD | First Lien Senior Secured Term Loan | 6.7 % Cash, 7.6 % PIK

rationale: E07 uses the PIK-inclusive all-in convention for interest_rate. The extracted holding for A.T. Holdings II LTD stores interest_rate 6.7, which matches only the cash leg. The raw SOI row discloses 6.7% Cash and 7.6% PIK, making the all-in stated coupon 14.3%; storing only 6.7 understates the all-in coupon and is a real extraction gap.
